channel.title: Eastern Daily Press - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from Eastern Daily Press (edp24.co.uk)

item.title: Crash closes major A-road in both directions
item.description: A crash on the A146 near Thurton on the outskirts of Norwich is causing long tailbacks of traffic this evening.

item.title: Neighbours victorious as bid for three homes gets thrown out
item.description: Broadland District Council has thrown out plans to build three homes on a parcel of land behind 18 South Hill Road in Thorpe St Andrew.

item.title: Home Office contractor piles on pressure over plans to house 200 refugees in village
item.description: Government contractors are heaping pressure on a council to decide on controversial plans to house 200 refugees in Norfolk.

item.title: City folk frustrated as May council elections thrown in doubt
item.description: People in Norwich have called on its council to continue with May elections regardless of whether the council shows concerns over local government reorganisation.

item.title: Prominent businessman backs farm shop 'trying to be shut down' by neighbours
item.description: A farm shop that has disturbed neighbours and breached health and safety regulations has been served with two enforcement notices.

item.title: Frustration mounts over railway station where passengers cannot get to platform
item.description: Further calls have been made for an end to a situation which means disabled passengers at Wymondham railway station are not able to get to one of the platforms.

item.title: Seamstress leaves behind the West End for new venture in Norfolk hometown
item.description: Katy Keyworth is the founder of Cromer Seamstress, a business which offers sewing workshops, retreats, and private tuition on the north Norfolk coast.

item.title: Motorists warned of disruption as five-week closures in place on two roads
item.description: Motorists are being warned of disruption as two Norfolk village roads will close in the New Year.

item.title: Santa complains of poor wages and strikes in pre-Christmas moan
item.description: It was the night before Christmas Eve.

item.title: Joy as outstanding students honoured at awards ceremony
item.description: The outstanding achievements of more than 90 students have been honoured at a special awards ceremony in Lowestoft.
